title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The final arc of Umineko opens on a happy version of the Ushiromiya family's yearly gathering on Rokkenjima island, with young Ange present for once. Battler tries to show his sister Ange a comforting version of what happened twelve years earlier, but she insists on the truth and bargains her life for her aunt Eva's diary. The arc reveals motives behind the earlier murders and recasts the 'witches' as representations of outside theories about the case, weighing truth against closure.
life_message: Love and the stories we choose to believe can heal, but the story asks what truth is owed to those who grieve.
